instruction: On a separate sheet, determine the difference in Current Assets from 2014 to 2019.

metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating total change in Current Assets from 2014 to 2019. Verified with Python: 2014 CA=185682, 2019 CA=282148, change=282148-185682=96466. Custom getter searches Sheet2 for cell containing result value (flexible location), extracts formula to verify calculation was performed (not just typed), and checks formula references correct source data (2014 and 2019 rows). Custom metric verifies value matches, formula exists, and formula references both years' data.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly searches Sheet2 flexibly for any cell containing value ~96466 (lines 49-56), not hardcoded to specific cell location
Metric properly verifies calculation was performed via formula check: returns only 0.3 if no formula exists, 1.0 if proper formula with year references
Getter extracts formula and verifies it references both 2014 and 2019 data rows from Sheet1 (lines 76-96)
Complete instruction coverage: (1) separate sheet verified, (2) calculation verified via has_formula, (3) correct years verified via references_2014/2019, (4) correct value verified
Expected value 96466 is semantically correct: 2019 CA (282148) - 2014 CA (185682) = 96466, verified from actual data
Metric parameter handling is correct: uses expected.get('value'), not incorrect patterns like expected.get('rules')
Partial credit logic is sensible: 0.3 for typed value only, 0.7 for formula without proper year references, 1.0 for full verification
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S to persist calculations
